# CompareMalta.ai

> Malta's AI comparison site. Independent, daily-refreshed comparisons of bank accounts, savings, loans, mortgages, credit cards, business accounts, POS and card payments, fintech, money transfer, mobile and broadband plans, insurance, investing and restaurants in Malta, in English, Maltese and Italian. Every figure comes from the provider's own website; rankings use a published Blue score (0-10) and cannot be bought.

Last updated: 2026-11-25T08:45:13+00:00

Ask Blue, the site's AI assistant, answers questions from the same data at https://comparemalta.ai/#ask .

## Comparisons (English)

- [Business Accounts](https://comparemalta.ai/en/business-accounts/): Bank and EMI business accounts for SMEs, freelancers and holding companies in Malta. Top pick today: wamo wamo Business. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/business-accounts/index.md
- [POS & Card Payments](https://comparemalta.ai/en/pos/): Card readers, POS terminals and tap-to-pay for merchants in Malta. We work out what each option really costs per month at €5,000 and €20,000 of card sales, including fee-free allowances and plan fees. Top pick today: wamo Start (company). Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/pos/index.md
- [Current Accounts](https://comparemalta.ai/en/bank-accounts/): Personal current accounts: monthly fees, card fees and ATM charges abroad. Top pick today: MeDirect Current Account. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/bank-accounts/index.md
- [Savings & Term Deposits](https://comparemalta.ai/en/savings/): Term deposit and savings rates. Malta-licensed banks are covered by the Depositor Compensation Scheme up to €100,000. Top pick today: MeDirect Fixed Term 12M. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/savings/index.md
- [Personal Loans](https://comparemalta.ai/en/personal-loans/): Personal loans: interest, APRC, amount range and term. Top pick today: BNF Bank Personal Loan. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/personal-loans/index.md
- [Home Loans](https://comparemalta.ai/en/mortgages/): Home loan rates: variable / fixed, LTV and term. First-time-buyer products flagged. Top pick today: APS Bank Home Loan. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/mortgages/index.md
- [Credit Cards](https://comparemalta.ai/en/credit-cards/): Annual fee, interest, foreign transaction fee and rewards. Top pick today: BNF Bank Visa Credit. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/credit-cards/index.md
- [Fintech Apps](https://comparemalta.ai/en/fintech/): Digital accounts and card apps available in Malta: FX markup and monthly plans. Top pick today: N26 Standard. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/fintech/index.md
- [Money Transfer](https://comparemalta.ai/en/money-transfer/): Sending €1,000: fee, FX margin and speed (EUR→GBP / TRY / USD). Top pick today: wamo. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/money-transfer/index.md
- [FX & Currency Exchange](https://comparemalta.ai/en/fx/): Who gives you the most when you send or exchange €1,000 from Malta. Live quotes, refreshed every 6 hours and ranked by total cost against the mid-market rate (fee plus exchange-rate markup). Top pick today: Instarem EUR → USD. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/fx/index.md
- [Mobile Plans](https://comparemalta.ai/en/telco-mobile/): GO, Epic and Melita postpaid and prepaid plans. Top pick today: Melita Mobile Unlimited. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/telco-mobile/index.md
- [Broadband & TV](https://comparemalta.ai/en/telco-broadband/): Fibre speeds, prices and TV bundles. Top pick today: Epic Epic Fibre 1G. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/telco-broadband/index.md
- [Insurance](https://comparemalta.ai/en/insurance/): Car, home and health insurance starting prices. Top pick today: GasanMamo Motor Comprehensive. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/insurance/index.md
- [Investing](https://comparemalta.ai/en/investing/): Brokers and apps with access to the MSE and global markets. Top pick today: Trade Republic Securities Account. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/investing/index.md
- [Restaurants](https://comparemalta.ai/en/restaurants/): Malta & Gozo restaurants by area, cuisine and budget, with fresh picks every day. Top pick today: Kebab Factory Valletta, Msida, St Julian's and more. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/restaurants/index.md
- [Supermarkets & Groceries](https://comparemalta.ai/en/groceries/): Malta's supermarkets side by side: price level, a measured basket comparison, loyalty schemes, delivery, opening hours and what each one does best. Top pick today: Lidl Discount supermarket. Markdown: https://comparemalta.ai/en/groceries/index.md

## Data

- Every category as JSON: https://comparemalta.ai/data/cat-<slug>.json (slugs: business-accounts, pos, bank-accounts, savings, personal-loans, mortgages, credit-cards, fintech, money-transfer, fx, telco-mobile, telco-broadband, insurance, investing, restaurants, groceries)
- FX (ECB) https://comparemalta.ai/data/fx.json, markets https://comparemalta.ai/data/markets.json, news https://comparemalta.ai/data/news.json
- All current tables in one file: https://comparemalta.ai/llms-full.txt
